Still possible but less likely than a two-adult household due to the robustness of the evening routine which implies shared household management, though not strictly proven.

hypotheses.persona: Shared housing with a child guest
hypotheses.rationale: Remains discarded as primary. The permanence of items and daily intensity make this highly unlikely.
